title.value: Replay Buffer with Local Forgetting for Adapting to Local Environment Changes in Deep Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title accurately summarizes the paper's focus on replay buffer techniques for adapting to environmental changes using deep reinforcement learning.
title.quote: R EPLAY B UFFER WITH L OCAL F ORGETTING FOR A DAPTING TO L OCAL E NVIRONMENT C HANGES IN D EEP M ODEL -B ASED R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING

extractions.description: This paper introduces a variation of the traditional replay buffer, known as LOFO (Local Forgetting) replay buffer, which is designed to improve the adaptivity of deep model-based reinforcement learning methods to local environmental changes. By removing samples only from the local neighborhood of newly observed samples, this method aims to maintain the accuracy of deep world models across the relevant state-space. The effectiveness of the LOFO replay buffer is demonstrated on deep versions of Dyna, PlaNet, and DreamerV2 methods across different domains, showing that it improves adaptivity by addressing catastrophic forgetting and stale data interference.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The main focus of the paper is on improving model-based reinforcement learning techniques to adapt to local changes. While this has potential applications in various fields, including ecological and climate systems, the central theme is not sustainable development itself.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This capability can be valuable in many scenarios, such as... effective adaptation to certain forms of non-stationary (for example, consider a navigation task where a road is suddenly blocked requiring instant re-planning).

primary_category.quote: One particularly challenging requirement is that the learned world model has to be sufficiently accurate throughout relevant parts of the state-space.

applications.value: Adaptation of RL algorithms to local environmental changes
applications.justification: Although the paper doesn't focus on sustainability applications, the algorithm's ability to adapt to local changes has potential applications in environmental monitoring systems.
applications.quote: We demonstrate this by applying our replay-buffer variation... demonstrating that deep model-based methods can adapt effectively as well to local changes in the environment.
